chung.Description: This digital painting course equips students with the foundational knowledge and skills to create original artworks in Adobe Photoshop, applying form, light, color, composition, and material rendering through iterative studio practice and critique. AI-powered tools may be used for ideation, composition, and refinement, while the final artwork is executed through original manual painting.
chung.StudentTasks:
1. Class attendance is strongly encouraged. Attend at least 80% of class hours in order to be accepted to the final examination

2. Actively participate in class activities

3. Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class

4. Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose

5. Read the textbook in advance

6. Access the course website (https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/) for up-to-date information

clo: Recognise the use of basic tools and techniques of Adobe Photoshop software for digital painting.
Explain the principles of art forms, color theory, light and composition as they apply to digital painting.
Execute textures and materials in digital paintings to enhance realism.

Apply basic and advanced digital painting techniques, integrating AI-powered tools for ideation, composition, and refinement, to create original artworks — including still life, portraits, and landscapes.

Design and create a comprehensive digital painting project that incorporates composition, lighting, color, and texture, using traditional digital painting skills with AI tools as aids for ideation, composition, and refinement.
Demonstrate a professional and positive attitude toward the creative process in digital painting.
danhGia: Recognise the use of basic tools and techniques of Adobe Photoshop software for digital painting.

Lab 1: Basic Tools and Techniques
1. Setting up a New Project:
- Create a new digital painting project in Photoshop. Document each step with screenshots and annotations. Ensure your documentation covers:
- Setting the canvas size and resolution (2048px*1152px 72dpi)
- Choosing the color mode (RGB or CMYK).
- Saving your project with appropriate file formats (.psd)
2. Customization:
Customize your Photoshop workspace to suit your workflow. Take screenshots of your customized workspace and explain (100 words) why you arranged the tools and panels in that particular layout.
Recognise the use of basic tools and techniques of Adobe Photoshop software for digital painting.

Lab 2: Basic Tools and Techniques
- Create a value scale from pure black to pure white with 10 separate steps. Paint a simple still life using only the shades in the value scale. Submit the value scale and the still life painting.
- Use Hue/Saturation, Color Balance, and Vibrance adjustments to modify the colors of the still life painting. Submit the original image and five different color-adjusted versions, each representing a different adjustment. (can use the Quick Selection tool and the Pen tool to make selections to modify the color of each part of the still life painting.)
Apply advanced digital painting techniques by transforming a grayscale image into a full-color artwork, using color theory and harmony principles.

Lab 3: Advance Techniques
- Begin by drawing a grayscale image of a simple object or scene.
- Add color to different parts of the image while maintaining the original values (see textbook pages 93 to 110).
- Use layers to separate different elements for easier adjustments and flexibility.
- Submit the original grayscale image and the final colored version (psd format with layers), along with a brief description (100 words and screenshots) of your colorization process.
Apply principles of form, light, and composition while rendering textures and materials through digital painting techniques.

Lab 4: Texture study
- Create a still life digital painting that incorporates wood, glass, and metallic elements, demonstrating your understanding and application of the characteristics and techniques for rendering each material.
- Select reference images for a wooden object, a glass object, and a metallic object.
Sketch a still life composition that includes all three objects, ensuring a balanced arrangement.
- Attach screenshots of different stages of your painting process, showcasing the development from initial sketch to final render.
Create a digital portrait to practice accurate proportions, light and shadow, texture rendering, and advanced painting techniques.

Lab 5: Portrait - Human Head
-Create a detailed digital painting of a human head, demonstrating your understanding and application of the techniques covered in this subject.
- Attach screenshots of different stages of painting process, showcasing the development from initial sketch to final render.

Create a digital landscape that applies basic and advanced painting techniques to render trees, sky, and water. AI-powered tools may be used for ideation, composition, and refinement, while the final artwork is executed through original manual painting.

Lab 6: AI-Assisted Landscape – Trees, Sky, and Water
Create a detailed digital painting of a landscape that includes trees, sky, and water, demonstrating your understanding and application of the techniques covered in this subject. AI-powered tools may be used for ideation, composition, and refinement, while the final artwork is executed through original manual painting.

Submission Requirements:
- Submit the final landscape painting.
- Include the reference images used.
- Attach screenshots of different stages of your painting process, showcasing the development from initial sketch to final render.

Create a comprehensive digital painting that incorporates composition, lighting, color, and texture. The project must demonstrate traditional digital painting skills, with AI tools supporting ideation, composition, and refinement.

Lab 7: Final Project – AI-Supported Comprehensive Digital Painting
- This assignment will allow you to apply and demonstrate the full range of skills and knowledge acquired throughout the course
- This assignment provides an opportunity to express yourself artistically and showcase your acquired skills. The project must demonstrate traditional digital painting skills, with AI tools supporting ideation, composition, and refinement.

Requirements:

- Submit the final.
